The '''Velmorian calendar''' was the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|calendar]] in use on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. According to [[Velmorian]] reckoning, the 313th [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Mrid]] was approximately [[20 BBY/Legends|20 years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
